name: monsters
caption:
IF OUR CORE FIVE WERE MONSTERS 🎮🏀 Every Raptor gets a monster partner.

🦖 Scottie Barnes = Clawrex: the franchise raptor, 23.5 PPG and 2.3 steals
🔥 RJ Barrett = Emberfox: three tails, lights it up for 21.6 PPG
⚡ Immanuel Quickley = Zapmink: quick hands, 5.8 APG
🪨 Jakob Poeltl = Mossgolem: gentle giant, 61.1% from the field
🦏 Collin Murray-Boyles = Stonehorn: nothing moves him, 5.0 RPG

Who did we get wrong? 👇
